source.content: public class QueryGuideSoqlStubProvider implements SoqlStubProvider { public List<SObject> handleSoqlQuery(Schema.SObjectType targetType, String query, Map<String,Object> binds) { Map<String,Object> row = new Map<String,Object>{'Id' => '001000000000999', 'Name' => 'Stubbed'}; return Test.createStubQueryRows(targetType, new List<Map<String,Object>>{row}); } public Object clone() { return this; } }

@isTest private class QueryRuntimeSOQLSOSLGuideBehaviorTest { @isTest static void guideBehaviorRunsLocally() { Account alpha = new Account(Name = 'Alpha', Rating = 'Hot', AnnualRevenue = 100); Account beta = new Account(Name = 'Beta', Rating = 'Warm', AnnualRevenue = 250); Account empty = new Account(Name = 'No Revenue'); Account quoted = new Account(Name = 'Bob\'s Shop', Rating = 'Hot', AnnualRevenue = 50); insert new List<Account>{alpha, beta, empty, quoted}; Contact child = new Contact(LastName = 'Trail', AccountId = alpha.Id); insert child; String wanted = 'Alpha'; List<Account> boundRows = [SELECT Id, Name FROM Account WHERE Name = :wanted ORDER BY Name DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10 OFFSET 0]; System.assertEquals(1, boundRows.size()); List<Account> withRows = [SELECT Id, Name FROM Account WHERE Name = :wanted WITH USER_MODE]; System.assertEquals(1, withRows.size()); List<Account> scopedRows = [SELECT Id, Name FROM Account USING SCOPE everything WHERE Name != null ORDER BY Name]; System.assertEquals(4, scopedRows.size()); Integer lockedLoop = 0; for (Account row : [SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE Name != null FOR UPDATE]) { lockedLoop++; } System.assert(lockedLoop >= 4); Account single = [SELECT Id, Name FROM Account WHERE Id = :alpha.Id LIMIT 1]; System.assertEquals('Alpha', single.Name); List<Account> ordered = [SELECT Id, Name FROM Account WHERE Name != null ORDER BY Name ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 2 OFFSET 1]; System.assertEquals(2, ordered.size()); List<Account> logical = [SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE (Rating = 'Hot' OR Rating = 'Warm') AND Name != null ORDER BY Name]; System.assertEquals(3, logical.size()); List<Account> escaped = [SELECT Id, Name FROM Account WHERE Name = 'Bob\'s Shop']; System.assertEquals(1, escaped.size()); System.assertEquals('Bob\'s Shop', escaped[0].Name); Contact parentRow = [SELECT Id, Account.Name FROM Contact WHERE AccountId = :alpha.Id LIMIT 1]; System.assertEquals('Alpha', parentRow.Account.Name); Account withChildren = [SELECT Id, Name, (SELECT Id, LastName FROM Contacts ORDER BY LastName LIMIT 1) FROM Account WHERE Id = :alpha.Id LIMIT 1]; List<Contact> contacts = withChildren.Contacts; System.assertEquals(1, contacts.size()); System.assertEquals('Trail', contacts[0].LastName); Integer looped = 0; for (Account row : [SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE Name != null]) { looped++; } System.assert(looped >= 4); List<AggregateResult> grouped = [SELECT Rating rating, COUNT(Id) total, SUM(AnnualRevenue) revenue FROM Account WHERE Rating != null GROUP BY Rating HAVING COUNT(Id) > 0 ORDER BY Rating]; System.assertEquals(2, grouped.size()); System.assertNotEquals(null, grouped[0].get('rating')); System.assertNotEquals(null, grouped[0].get('total')); Integer countRows = Database.countQuery('SELECT COUNT() FROM Account WHERE Name != null', AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assertEquals(4, countRows); Map<String,Object> binds = new Map<String,Object>(); binds.put('targetName', 'Beta'); List<Account> dynamicRows = Database.query('SELECT Id, Name FROM Account WHERE Name = :wanted'); System.assertEquals(1, dynamicRows.size()); List<SObject> bindRows = Database.queryWithBinds('SELECT Id, Name FROM Account WHERE Name = :targetName', binds, AccessLevel.USER_MODE); System.assertEquals(1, bindRows.size()); Integer bindCount = Database.countQueryWithBinds('SELECT COUNT() FROM Account WHERE Name = :targetName', binds, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); System.assertEquals(1, bindCount); Database.QueryLocator locator = Database.getQueryLocatorWithBinds('SELECT Id, Name FROM Account WHERE Name = :targetName', binds, AccessLevel.USER_MODE); Object iterator = locator.iterator(); System.assert(iterator.hasNext()); Account located = iterator.next(); System.assertEquals('Beta', located.Name); System.assert(!iterator.hasNext()); Test.setFixedSearchResults(new List<Id>{beta.Id, alpha.Id}); List<Account> soslRows = (List<Account>)Search.query('FIND {Trail*} IN ALL FIELDS RETURNING Account(Id, Name, FORMAT(AnnualRevenue) formattedRevenue, convertCurrency(AnnualRevenue) convertedRevenue, toLabel(Rating) ratingLabel ORDER BY Name LIMIT 1)', AccessLevel.USER_MODE)[0]; System.assertEquals(1, soslRows.size()); System.assertEquals('Alpha', soslRows[0].Name); System.assertEquals('100.0', soslRows[0].get('formattedRevenue')); System.assertEquals(100.0, soslRows[0].get('convertedRevenue')); System.assertEquals('Hot Label', soslRows[0].get('ratingLabel')); List<Account> soslWhereRows = (List<Account>)Search.query('FIND {Account*} IN ALL FIELDS RETURNING Account(Id, Name WHERE Name = \'Beta\')')[0]; System.assertEquals(1, soslWhereRows.size()); System.assertEquals(beta.Id, soslWhereRows[0].Id); System.assertEquals(false, Test.isSoqlStubDefined(Account.SObjectType)); Test.createSoqlStub(Account.SObjectType, new QueryGuideSoqlStubProvider()); System.assert(Test.isSoqlStubDefined(Account.SObjectType)); List<Account> stubRows = [SELECT Id, Name FROM Account WHERE Name = 'Stubbed']; System.assertEquals(1, stubRows.size()); System.assertEquals('Stubbed', stubRows[0].Name); } }
